{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to ensure clean state
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Now identify and remove the 6 QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
# They are not real orders and would skew any revenue-based analysis
sales_clean = sales[sales['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Now check: how many orders are actually completed (not refunded)?
completed_orders = sales_clean[sales_clean['status'] == 'completed']
num_completed = len(completed_orders)

# Output the count
print(num_completed)"}
